S7 Class for the Unpenalized Parametric Term

Source: R/term_classes.R
LinparTerm.Rd

A subclass of additive_term for the unpenalized parametric block built from a one-sided formula through model.matrix. Constructed by linpar, and implicitly by interpret_formula, which collects the bare covariates of a model formula into one term of this class.

Usage

LinparTerm(
  label = character(0),
  X = NULL,
  coef_names = character(0),
  blueprint = list(),
  penalty = NULL,
  formula = NULL
)

Arguments

label

A character string prefixed to the coefficient names when non-empty.

X

The design block, filled by term_build.

coef_names

The coefficient names, filled by term_build.

blueprint

The information needed to reproduce the mapping on new data, filled by term_build.

penalty

The penalty on the term's coefficients, or NULL.

formula

The one-sided formula defining the block.

Value

An object of class LinparTerm.

See also

linpar

Examples

S7::S7_inherits(linpar(~1), LinparTerm)
#> [1] TRUE
